title: In this town, every basketball court turns its lights off at 9 PM

lines.text: In this town, every basketball court turns its lights off at nine P.M. *Sharp*.
Coach Dan says, if you're not good by nine, you'll never be *good*.
Except *one* court. The old court behind the park stays lit until *midnight*.
And that's where I practice. Every. Single. Night.
Coach Dan cut me from the team. *Twice*.
Mister Moe, the old janitor, always sweeps nearby. Even at midnight.
The light bill on the pole says, paid, R.M.
And there's a faded jersey in his window. Number *twenty-three*.
Then two players got hurt, right before the championship.
The team needed one more player. *Me*.
Last ten seconds. Down by one. They gave me the ball.
I looked at the stands, and Mister Moe was in the front row. Wearing number *twenty-three*.
After the game, Coach Dan told me the truth.
Mister Moe was the best player this town ever had. He hurt his knee before his big game, and never got his chance.
So for three years, he paid for that light, so *I* would get mine.
In this town, the lights go off at nine. Unless someone *believes* in you.
